description: Master services agreement for managed IT services between two fictional companies, 12 A4 pages, written in python-docx with literal clause numbers (1., 1.1, 1.1.1) in hanging indents and converted by LibreOffice (Caladea body, Carlito headings, footer "Page N of M"), with three schedules including a service level table and a signature block. Seven edits: payment term in clause 5.2.1; a new clause 8.3 (emergency changes) inserted, so the old clauses 8.3 and 8.4 and sub-clauses 8.4.1-8.4.3 are renumbered 8.4, 8.5 and 8.5.1-8.5.3 (renumbering is a consequence, not listed); a wrong cross-reference corrected in clause 12.1.4; the liability cap percentage in clause 12.3.1; clause 13.3 (the last clause of clause 13) deleted; "exclusive" to "non-exclusive" jurisdiction in clause 19.2; and the platform availability target in Schedule 2. Re-flow and footer page numbers change only as consequences. Producer: LibreOffice Writer 24.2 (python-docx .docx -> soffice --convert-to pdf), Caladea/Carlito.

truth.new: Where a Change is needed urgently to protect the security or availability of the Services
truth.note: New clause 8.3 (whole clause). The following clauses 8.3, 8.4, 8.4.1, 8.4.2 and 8.4.3 become 8.4, 8.5, 8.5.1, 8.5.2 and 8.5.3; that renumbering is a consequence of the insertion.

Cross-reference corrected in clause 12.1.4 (the indemnity is clause 9.4.1). Typed "number" because only the clause number changes; "replace" is also a fair reading. The clause label 9.4.2 itself is unchanged.

truth.old: The Supplier shall notify the Customer within ten Business Days if any of the policies is cancelled, suspended or not renewed
truth.note: Whole clause 13.3 (label "13.3" and text) deleted; it was the last clause of clause 13, so nothing is renumbered.
Target of SL1 (availability of the hosted platform) in the Schedule 2 table.
